author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬೆಳೆಯುತಿರೆ ಎತ್ತರಕೆ ತಲೆಬಾಗಿ ನಡೆಯುತಿರು
ಕಳೆಯುತಿರು ಮಮಕಾರ ನಿನ್ನನೀನರಿತು
ಸೆಳೆಯುವವು ತಮ್ಮೆಡೆಗೆ ಆರು ಅರಿಗಳು ನಿನ್ನ
ಕೊಳೆಯದೆಯೆ ಜೀವಿಸಿರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: As you grow taller, walk with your head bowed;
keep shedding possessiveness by knowing yourself;
the six inner enemies will pull you toward them;
live without rotting, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The higher we rise, the humbler we should be. Know yourself, let go of ‘mine’, and resist the six inner enemies (desire, anger, greed, delusion, pride and envy) that would corrupt a life.
